SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 6
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: INDIVIDUALS WHO PAY ANNUAL DUES, AS DETERMINED BY THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS, TO THE ASSOCIATION BECOME MEMBERS FOR THAT FISCAL YEAR. THERE IS ONE CLASS OF MEMBERS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 7A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: AT THE ANNUAL MEMBERS MEETING, MEMBERS VOTE ON THE ELECTION OF DIRECTORS BASED UPON THE EXPIRATION OF EXISTING DIRECTORS' TERMS. PER OUR BYLAWS, THE ASSOCIATION IS AUTHORIZED NUMBER OF DIRECTORS IS 48; 24 OF WHOM SHALL BE SUBJECT TO VOTE BY THE MEMBERS, AND 24 OF WHOM SHALL BE DESIGNATED BY THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: MANAGEMENT REVIEWS THE FORM 990, THEN THE AUDIT COMMITTEE REVIEWS AND APPROVES. THE ORGANIZATION MAKES THE FINAL VERSION OF THE FORM 990 AVAILABLE TO ALL BOARD MEMBERS THROUGH ITS PORTAL PRIOR TO SUBMISSION TO THE IRS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: A CONFLICT OF INTEREST QUESTIONNAIRE IS DELIVERED ANNUALLY TO THE BOARD MEMBERS. BOARD MEMBERS ARE ASKED TO BRING POTENTIAL CONFLICTS OF INTEREST TO THE CHIEF EXECUTIVE DIRECT COMMITTEE. THE CHIEF EXECUTIVE DIRECT COMMITTEE REGULARLY DISCUSSES POTENTIAL CONFLICTS & SOME MATTERS ARE BROUGHT TO THE ENTIRE BOARD OF DIRECTORS. IF A CONFLICT OF INTEREST ARISES, SUCH BOARD MEMBER IS NOT PERMITTED TO VOTE ON THE TRANSACTION. CONFLICT OF INTEREST FOR OFFICERS AND KEY EMPLOYEES ARE COVERED IN THE EMPLOYEE HANDBOOK AND IS PROHIBITED. IF A CONFLICT OF INTEREST ARISES IT IS BROUGHT TO THE ATTENTION OF THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE AND BOARD IF APPROPRIATE. THERE HAVE BEEN NO INCIDENCES OF CONFLICT DURING THE YEAR ENDING JUNE 30, 2024.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: COMPENSATION FOR THE CEO IS REVIEWED AND NEGOTIATED BY THE CEO COMPENSATION COMMITTEE AND APPROVED BY THE BOARD. THE PROCESS IS BASED ON COMPARABLE DATA AND IS DOCUMENTED IN THE MINUTES OF THE BOARD MEETING. THE MOST RECENT PROCESS WAS CONCLUDED WITH BOARD APPROVAL IN SPETEMBER 2024.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION MAKES ITS GOVERNING DOCUMENTS, CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY AND FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC UPON REQUEST. ADDITIONALLY, THE COMBINED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS OF THE SAN DIEGO SYMPHONY ORCHESTRA ASSOCIATION AND SAN DIEGO SYMPHONY FOUNDATION ARE SUBJECT TO AN ANNUAL INDEPENDENT AUDIT. THE AUDIT REPORT IS AVAILABLE ON THE SAN DIEGO SYMPHONY'S WEBSITE AND IS ALSO AVAILABLE UPON REQUEST.
